world.title: Pope Leo XIV to be discharged from hospital
world.summary: Pope Leo XIV is set to be discharged from Gemelli Hospital after five days of treatment. Doctors Dr. Luigi Carbone and Professor Stefano Margaritora confirmed his recovery, stating he is fit to leave. The Holy See Press Office released the information on Saturday morning, indicating that the Pope underwent necessary medical procedures and is now in good health.

world.title: Japan's MMX mission set to grab a piece of Mars's moon Phobos
world.summary: Japan's MMX mission is scheduled to launch on Monday, aiming to collect a 10-gram sample of Martian moon Phobos and return it to Earth. If successful, this will mark the first time a sample from a moon of Mars is brought back. The mission represents a significant step in planetary exploration and understanding of Mars's natural satellites.

world.title: Tel Aviv-Vienna flight makes emergency landing after bomb threat
world.summary: An Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv to Vienna made an emergency landing in Sofia, Bulgaria, due to a bomb threat signal received by the crew. The aircraft, carrying six crew members and 51 passengers, prompted a security inspection upon landing. Authorities investigated the threat, ensuring the safety of all individuals on board during the incident.

business.title: Stocks in news: Vedanta, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, HFCL, IREDA, Zen Tech and Oil India
business.summary: Indian equities rebounded as information technology stocks saw sustained buying interest. The Nifty 50 index closed at 23,146, marking a 0.65% increase. Strong quarterly earnings from companies like HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank improved asset quality and bolstered investor confidence. Market participants are expected to monitor upcoming corporate announcements, which may influence future market trends.

business.title: Tata Sons breaks from the past and drops Article 118 reference in Chandrasekaran’s third-term resolution
business.summary: Tata Sons has deviated from its previous practices by omitting Article 118 in the resolution for Natarajan Chandrasekaran’s third term as chairman. Article 118 mandates the formation of a selection committee for new chairman appointments, a step not taken during Chandrasekaran's reappointment on September 17. This decision was highlighted by Tata Trusts chair Noel Tata in a recent filing.

business.title: 3 smallcaps where FIIs sharply raised stakes in Q2 FY27
business.summary: Foreign institutional investors (FIIs) increased their stakes in three smallcap stocks during Q2 FY27, reflecting heightened interest despite market volatility. Factors such as strong growth, new orders, and expansion plans are critical for these companies to maintain business momentum. This trend follows a prior analysis of microcap stocks with significant FII holdings amid fluctuating market conditions.

technology.title: 5 Powerful Android Phones To Consider Instead Of The OnePlus 16
technology.summary: The OnePlus 16, featuring Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a 9,000 mAh battery, and a high-resolution display, is not available in the U.S. However, five alternative Android phones are recommended for users seeking more powerful options. These alternatives cater to gamers and those using demanding applications, offering comparable or superior specifications and features.

technology.title: The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is (almost) free this weekend - how to claim
technology.summary: The Apple iPhone 18 Pro is available for nearly free this weekend through T-Mobile, offering a $1,000 discount. To take advantage of this promotion, customers must switch to T-Mobile, bring their existing number, or trade in an eligible phone in any condition while signing up for an Experience Beyond plan. Preorders for the iPhone Duo are now open.

technology.title: Samsung Offers Up To Rs 20,000 Cashback On AI Appliances During Diwali Sale 2026
technology.summary: Samsung India has launched its Diwali Sale 2026, featuring offers on select Bespoke AI appliances. Customers can receive cashback of up to ₹20,000, with financing options starting at ₹888 per month and zero-down-payment plans. The promotion also includes eligible extended warranty benefits. These offers are available until November 15, aiming to attract consumers during the festive season.

sports.title: Babar Azam achieves historic milestone, joins Inzamam and Miandad in elite Pakistan list
sports.summary: Babar Azam achieved a significant milestone on Sunday by becoming the fifth Pakistan batter to score 16,000 international runs. This accomplishment occurred during the first ODI of the tri-series against Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi. Babar joins the elite list alongside former players Inzamam-ul-Haq and Javed Miandad, marking a notable achievement in his cricketing career.

sports.title: Bangladesh lock in new captain to replace Sultana Joty
sports.summary: Bangladesh has appointed Nahida Akter as the new captain of their T20I team, replacing Nigar Sultana Joty. Joty stepped down from her captaincy role last month to concentrate on her playing career. Nahida, a left-arm spinner, will lead the team moving forward, marking a significant change in leadership for Bangladesh's women's cricket squad.

health.title: Live Chat: Doctors Explain Breast Cancer Risk, Prevention And Myths
health.summary: On World Breast Cancer Day, ten doctors discussed breast cancer risk factors, early warning signs, screening options, and prevention strategies. They addressed common myths, such as the potential cancer risks associated with bras, deodorants, and breast injuries, as well as the misconception that a normal mammogram eliminates the possibility of breast cancer. The discussion aimed to educate the public.

health.title: Ebola outbreak reaches eighth province of DR Congo
health.summary: Two cases of Ebola virus disease, including one fatality, have been confirmed in North Ubangi province, Democratic Republic of Congo. This development marks the spread of the outbreak to eight provinces across the country. Health authorities are monitoring the situation closely as they work to contain the virus and prevent further transmission among the population.

health.title: How to prevent an AI-created plague
health.summary: Future pandemics may arise from individuals empowered by artificial intelligence, posing significant risks. A proposed three-track plan aims to address this potential threat. The historical context of plagues, such as those depicted in the Iliad, highlights the enduring nature of disease as a weapon. Strategies to mitigate AI-related health crises are essential for public safety and preparedness.

science.title: SN 1181 gets its sharpest view yet: new images reveal a zombie star
science.summary: Gemini North has unveiled new images of Pa 30, the supernova remnant linked to SN 1181, providing the sharpest view of its debris to date. Utilizing the Gemini North telescope in Hawai’i, researchers identified red ionized sulfur and blue-green emissions, enhancing understanding of the remnants of this supernova. This advancement contributes to ongoing studies of stellar evolution and cosmic phenomena.

science.title: Study links Moon’s uneven hemispheres to Earth’s gravity
science.summary: Samples from the Moon's far side indicate that Earth's gravity contributed to uneven heating, which shaped the Moon's contrasting hemispheres billions of years ago. This finding, reported by Qazinform News Agency, highlights the influence of Earth's gravitational forces on lunar geology. The study provides new insights into the Moon's formation and its long-term geological evolution.

science.title: 63 Years Ago, A Cat Named Felicette Became The First Feline In Space
science.summary: On October 18, 1963, Felicette, a small black-and-white cat, became the first and only feline to travel into space and return safely. The mission lasted approximately 13 minutes. Initially dubbed Felix by the French media, her name was later corrected to Felicette after researchers confirmed her gender. This event marked a significant milestone in space exploration history.
